michael_customer: Our Private deployment's /console metrics page is showing zero for all token and latency charts since ~09:30 UTC. API traffic looks normal on our side, no errors and quota not hit. Any idea?
emma_support: Sorry about that — can you confirm if the tenant header is being forwarded from your ALB/nginx? We index metrics by tenant header (X-Redwood-Tenant) for Private installs.
michael_customer: We don't explicitly set that in our app, we rely on the edge to forward headers. curl works fine to the API but metrics still empty. Example request we hit: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://private.example.com/v1/generate`
emma_support: Can you run `curl -I` to check response headers and also `curl -v` to show request headers including X-Redwood-Tenant? If you can't add header client-side, send me recent request trace IDs from 09:25-09:35 UTC.
michael_customer: trace ids: trace-20250115-0927-1, trace-20250115-0930-3. We don't see X-Redwood-Tenant in `curl -v`.
mike_infra: On Private we usually rely on the ALB to add the tenant header. ALB rules changed last week during a config drift — it was removing custom headers on HTTP->HTTPS redirect. Can you share your ALB/nginx config?
michael_customer: simplified nginx config we use on the edge: ```server { listen 80; server_name private.example.com; location / { proxy_pass http://backend; } }```
emma_support: That explains it. Without `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;` the header isn't forwarded to the backend, so the metrics pipeline sees tenant=null and drops events. Our metrics ingestion has this rule: `if (tenant == null) { drop_event(); }` — that's why console charts are empty.
sre_jamie: Recommended fix: add header forwarding in nginx or configure ALB to preserve custom headers. Example: ```location / { proxy_pass http://backend; proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant; proxy_set_header Host $host; }``` Also ensure any redirect or rewrite preserves headers.
-ingrid_prod: For safety we can also add a fallback in the metrics ingestor: infer tenant from JWT `sub`/claim if header missing, but that'll be an opt-in config for Private customers. Escalating to eng-infra for a quick opt-in toggle.
emma_support: For a temporary workaround you can inject the header at the app level: `X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-corp` with test requests; that should populate the dashboard for new events. For historical missing events we can reprocess logs if you want — will need a support ticket and retention window confirmation.
michael_customer: Adding `proxy_set_header` fixed new metrics showing up. Please let us know when the opt-in fallback is available so we don't have to touch ALB rules across dozens of services. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployed config change for support opt-in flag to staging at 2025-01-15T11:40:00Z (id: deploy-789).
